summary: Boolean fuel-weight check in the pit subsystem: returns whether the fuel quantity dword_7D0B64 converted to weight (multiplied by 0.050000001) exceeds the product of two floats read from the structure pointed to by dword_7C54E0 at offsets 14724 and 14732. When dword_7D0B64 is not positive the function returns false without computing. ABI lead name Fuel_Weight_Computation; consumed as a boolean by three callers (sub_49D4C0, HUDFlagRendererMain, UIMessageCompose).

operations.description: If dword_7D0B64 <= 0, skip the computation and return false; the weight comparison only runs when the fuel quantity is positive.
Convert the integer fuel quantity dword_7D0B64 to a weight by casting to double and multiplying by the constant 0.050000001.
Read two floats from the structure pointed to by dword_7C54E0 at byte offsets 14724 and 14732 and multiply them together to form the comparison threshold.
Return whether the computed fuel weight is greater than the product of the two floats; return false when dword_7D0B64 is not positive.
